paragraphs.source_en: Grimaud was on his legs again as if by a spring. Athos then made him a sign to take up his basket and to walk on first. Grimaud obeyed. All that Grimaud gained by this momentary pantomime was to pass from the rear guard to the vanguard.

units.source_en: Grimaud was on his legs again as if by a spring.
Athos then made him a sign to take up his basket and to walk on first.
All that Grimaud gained by this momentary pantomime was to pass from the rear guard to the vanguard.

paragraphs.source_en: Arrived at the bastion, the four friends turned round.

units.source_en: Arrived at the bastion, the four friends turned round.

paragraphs.source_en: More than three hundred soldiers of all kinds were assembled at the gate of the camp; and in a separate group might be distinguished M. de Busigny, the dragoon, the Swiss, and the fourth bettor.

units.source_en: More than three hundred soldiers of all kinds were assembled at the gate of the camp; and in a separate group might be distinguished M. de Busigny, the dragoon, the Swiss, and the fourth bettor.

paragraphs.source_en: Athos took off his hat, placed it on the end of his sword, and waved it in the air.

units.source_en: Athos took off his hat, placed it on the end of his sword, and waved it in the air.

paragraphs.source_en: All the spectators returned him his salute, accompanying this courtesy with a loud hurrah which was audible to the four; after which all four disappeared in the bastion, whither Grimaud had preceded them.
